_about: Prompts and settings for tools/comfy_batch.py. Edit the style lines to steer the look; names and seeds come from the game data.
style: flat vector illustration in the style of 1960s space programme press art, clean geometric shapes, limited palette, soft two-tone shading, no outlines, no text, no logos
negative: cartoon, childlike, chibi, big round eyes, oversized head, clip art, emoji, space helmet, photograph, photorealistic, blurry, noisy, text, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, 3d render, deformed hands, extra limbs

portrait.prompt: Repaint image 1 in exactly the art style of image 2: a flat vector illustration like a 1960s magazine portrait, adult proportions, soft two-tone shading, clean shapes, no outlines. Keep the person from image 1: same face shape, skin tone, hair colour and hairstyle, eye colour, moustache or glasses if present, same expression. Head and shoulders of a {era} {nationality} {role}, {gender}, bare head with no helmet, in a {suit} flight suit, looking at the viewer, plain dark navy background.
portrait.t2i_prompt: Flat vector illustration like a 1960s magazine portrait, soft two-tone cel shading, clean shapes, no outlines, limited muted palette. Head and shoulders of a {age} {nationality} {role}, {gender}, {face} face, {skin} skin, {hair} {hair_style} hair, {eyes} eyes{extras}, calm confident expression, looking at the viewer, wearing a {suit} zip-front flight suit with a dark undershirt, plain dark navy background, centred, adult proportions, no helmet, no text.

hardware.prompt: Repaint this spacecraft silhouette as a {style}. Keep exactly the same outline, proportions and orientation. A {name}, {kind}, {nationality} space programme of the 1960s, centred, on a plain solid bright green background #00ff00.
hardware.t2i_prompt: Flat vector illustration like a 1960s magazine technical plate, soft two-tone cel shading, clean geometric shapes, no outlines, limited muted palette. {desc}, a {nationality} {kind} of the 1960s, whole vehicle visible, side view, centred, floating in empty space in front of a plain solid flat bright green chroma key background #00FF00.
